lead.title: Anthropic research paper reveals key findings on AI coding assistance
lead.summary: Two Minute Papers covers Anthropic's latest research on AI assistance and coding skills, highlighting what Claude reveals about AI's fundamental limitations in software development. The paper offers insights into where models excel and where human developers remain essential.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol outperforms in Claude Code over Anthropic's own Codex
items.summary: Developer Theo reports that OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model performs significantly better when used inside Claude Code than Anthropic's own Codex, suggesting interesting cross-model optimization dynamics and raising questions about model-IDE compatibility.
